parts.name: Lamp Base
parts.Basic_description: The lamp base is the upper mounting part of the pendant lamp, typically made of aluminum for durability and lightweight support.
parts.Functional_description: It attaches the lamp to the ceiling and provides structural stability for the hanging components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed to the ceiling and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Pendant Lamp Unit
parts.Basic_description: The pendant lamp unit is the main light-emitting component, typically made of glass to diffuse light evenly.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the bulb and directs light downward, serving as the primary illumination source.
parts.Movement_description: It hangs freely from the cord but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Power Cord
parts.Basic_description: The power cord is a flexible rubber-coated wire that connects the lamp to the electrical supply.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits electrical power from the ceiling connection to the lamp unit.
parts.Movement_description: It is flexible and can move slightly when the lamp is adjusted or touched.
